verification.validation: Patch checks cover AppShell phoneTitle and docked-bar end-space behavior, the shell suite, bounded WebAPI JSON capture, compaction, 1 MiB and 20 MiB executor/socket/client transfers, typed overflow, memory allocation, language adapters, typecheck, builds, documentation and version checks, package scans, and reproducible executor digests. No full gate, publication or NAS acceptance.

changes: AppShellPage.phoneTitle: true keeps a tab page's title bar on a phone; omitted, a tab page still has no title row.
A fill page whose last element is a docked bar (a UI footer bar such as AppActionBar, or an element marked data-ui-page-bar) has no end space under it; a scrolling page keeps it.
Raise compact JSON WebAPI replies to 20 MiB, with generated shared socket and language-client limits.
Stream stdout without retaining pretty output or a decoded tree; write the validated socket payload without a full-frame copy or tmpfs staging.
Return WEBAPI_REPLY_TOO_LARGE with the observed minimum byte size and limit; preserve operation budgets and mutation reconciliation.
Hold two shared output slots through socket delivery and keep raw/root inline and staging limits separate.
Record the changed executor digests; the matching immutable executor module release is required.
Align adapter metadata for the combined patch release.
